# Determining the Relationship Between Randy and Helen

## Building the Family Chain

Let me organize all the given relationships step by step:

| Relationship | Chain Direction |
|---|---|
| Roger is Willie's ancestor | Roger → Willie |
| Carl is Willie's descendant | Willie → Carl |
| Carl is Julie's ancestor | Carl → Julie |
| Julie is Jean's ancestor | Julie → Jean |
| Gerald is Jean's descendant | Jean → Gerald |
| Helen is Gerald's descendant | Gerald → Helen |

This gives us one continuous lineage:
$$\text{Roger} \to \text{Willie} \to \text{Carl} \to \text{Julie} \to \text{Jean} \to \text{Gerald} \to \text{Helen}$$

## Locating Randy

The only relationship involving Randy is:
> **Randy is Roger's descendant** → Roger → ... → Randy

Randy branches off from **Roger** but is not placed anywhere within the main chain (Roger → Willie → Carl → Julie → Jean → Gerald → Helen).

## Conclusion

- **Helen** is a descendant of **Roger** (through the main chain).
- **Randy** is also a descendant of **Roger** (on a separate branch).

Therefore, **Randy and Helen share a common ancestor: Roger**.
